scope: Three CLOSED clear-track standing laps; one run per predeclared setting, not a multi-seed racing champion or traffic-avoidance proof.
selection_reason: Fastest clean observed lap with balanced reductions in total variation, rate/acceleration RMS and rapid reversals; near-identical nominal capture.
sigma2_negative_result: Lower>1Hzcommand RMS alone did not yield the best handling: lap slower than baseline, steering acceleration RMS higher, more command notches/reversals.
redactions: Absolute run locations and raw input hash-location indices omitted.

actual_body_heading_diagnostic.scope: Actual simulator body-yaw finite differences, no measured tire-force claim; high-pass is offline measurement only.
